topic: Mano spills the milk and tells the truth instead of hiding it.

episode.title: Mano Aur Sheru: Doodh Gir Gaya!

shots.narration: ارے، دودھ گر گیا، اب مانو کیا کرے گی؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful Pakistani house courtyard beneath a neem tree, a low table with a plain bowl of milk, rounded 3D family animation, soft sunlight, no text.
shots.action: Mano, a white kitten with orange patches, blue eyes and a red ribbon bell, bumps the bowl with her paw, spilling milk onto the tiles.
shots.mood: Wide blue eyes, raised paw, bright gentle surprise.

shots.narration: مانو تو بس پیالے کے پاس کھیل رہی تھی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit courtyard tiles beside the low table, tipped plain bowl and a small milk puddle, colourful rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano lowers her raised paw beside the spilled milk.
shots.mood: Drooping ears and a small embarrassed expression.

shots.narration: [whispers] چٹائی رکھ دوں تو دودھ چھپ جائے گا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Pakistani courtyard with a small woven mat beside the milk puddle, neem shadows, soft 3D family film look, no text.
shots.action: Mano drags the edge of the woven mat toward the puddle.
shots.mood: Hunched shoulders and a hesitant sideways glance.

shots.narration: اتنے میں شیرو بھی صحن میں آ گیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard doorway facing the low table, milk puddle still uncovered and mat beside it, colourful 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru, a brown desi dog with a white chest, pointy ears and a green collar, walks into the courtyard beside Mano.
shots.mood: Sheru has relaxed ears and kind eyes; Mano looks uneasy.

shots.narration: مانو رک گئی، کیا اسے سچ بتانا چاہیے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard tiles with the mat short of the milk puddle, Sheru facing Mano, soft sunlight, rounded 3D look, no text.
shots.action: Mano releases the edge of the mat.
shots.mood: Mano looks thoughtful; Sheru waits with a gentle expression.

shots.narration: [sighs] شیرو، دودھ مجھ سے گرا ہے، معاف کرنا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunlit Pakistani courtyard beside the tipped bowl and uncovered milk, friendly 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano points her paw toward herself while facing Sheru.
shots.mood: Honest eye contact, lowered ears and a small apologetic face.

shots.narration: شیرو نے پیار سے سر ہلایا، غلطی ہو جاتی ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard beneath the neem tree, milk puddle visible beside both friends, soft colourful 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru gives Mano a gentle nod.
shots.mood: Warm reassuring eyes and Mano's ears beginning to lift.

shots.narration: مانو فوراً صفائی کے لیے کپڑا لے آئی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard wall with a low basket of plain cleaning cloths, soft sunlight and rounded 3D shapes, no text.
shots.action: Mano pulls a clean cloth from the low basket.
shots.mood: Bright attentive eyes and a determined little stance.

shots.narration: [excited] چلو، مل کر صحن صاف کرتے ہیں!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard floor with the small milk puddle, plain tipped bowl nearby, colourful 3D family film look, no text.
shots.action: Mano and Sheru press the cleaning cloth onto the puddle together.
shots.mood: Focused friendly faces and cooperative side-by-side poses.

shots.narration: مانو نے آخری قطرہ بھی صاف کر دیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, nearly clean courtyard tiles beneath the low table, Sheru sitting nearby, soft neem shadows, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano wipes away the final small drop of milk.
shots.mood: Clean gleaming tiles and proud gentle smiles.

shots.narration: سچ بتا کر مانو کا دل ہلکا ہو گیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, freshly cleaned Pakistani courtyard, upright empty bowl on the low table, rooftop stairs behind the friends, soft 3D animation, no text.
shots.mood: Relaxed ears, warm smiles and peaceful afternoon sunlight.

shots.narration: [excited] ہمیشہ سچ بولو؛ اگلی بار چھت پر پتنگ کس کی ہوگی؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Pakistani rooftop with a tall parapet, a plain colourful kite resting safely on the floor, warm 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano and Sheru tilt their heads toward the colourful kite.
shots.mood: Curious bright eyes, friendly rounded shapes and golden sunlight.

episode.endHook: اگلی بار چھت پر رنگین پتنگ کس کی ہوگی؟
episode.description: مانو سے دودھ گر گیا، تو وہ اسے چھپانے لگی۔ دیکھیے، شیرو کے ساتھ مل کر وہ سچ بولنا اور اپنی غلطی درست کرنا کیسے سیکھتی ہے۔
